name: WP Engine Staging Deploy
description: Deploys the theme to WP Engine staging when a pull request MERGES into the default branch, and on demand from any branch via Run workflow. Takes a labeled pre-deploy restore point. Requires the WPE_SSHG_KEY_PRIVATE secret, the WPE_STAGE_ENV variable, and — for backups — WPE_API_USER_ID / WPE_API_PASSWORD secrets plus the BACKUP_NOTIFICATION_EMAIL variable.
